verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine. It serves on 127.0.0.1, ships on-device iOS, Android, Windows and macOS apps, and downloads models to a user-chosen --target-dir, so data location is implicitly whatever machine the user runs it on. However, the evidence never makes an explicit data-residency or no-telemetry statement, and there is no region selection as such. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that prompts and data never leave the device, documented data-handling or telemetry policy, and independent corroboration of local-only operation.
